top_signals.title: Coinbase, Moov to bring stablecoin payment infrastructure to community banks and credit unions
top_signals.summary: The integration will use Coinbase's Payments API and custodial wallets to embed stablecoin rails into Moov's existing payments platform.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
